definitions.gloss: defensive capability; defense strength; military defense power
definitions.explanation: The ability of a nation, organization, or entity to defend itself. Most commonly used in discussions of national security and military policy.

examples.japanese: {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増強|ぞうきょう}→増強：19103_zoukyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: Japan indicated a policy of bolstering its defense capabilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{情勢|じょうせい}→情勢：12739_jousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不安定|ふあんてい}→不安定：11318_fuantei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: As the international situation becomes unstable, countries are advancing reviews of their defense capabilities.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧ (defense, national defense) + {力|りょく} (power, capability). A key term in Japanese political and news vocabulary, appearing frequently in discussions about the Self-Defense Forces (⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧), defense budgets, and security policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧: strengthening defense capabilities
- {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増強|ぞうきょう}→増強：19103_zoukyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bolster defense capabilities
- {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧: development of defense capabilities
- {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧: review of defense capabilities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軍事力|ぐんじりょく}→軍事力：23289_gunjiryoku⟧: military power — broader, includes offensive capacity; used for countries with full militaries
- ⟦{戦力|せんりょく}→戦力：18977_senryoku⟧: war potential, fighting strength — the capacity to wage war; constitutionally sensitive term in Japan
- ⟦{抑止力|よくしりょく}→抑止力：15454_yokushiryoku⟧: deterrence — the power to prevent attack by threatening retaliation
